title: EnSurv: Deep Generative Survival Modeling with Application to Kidney Graft Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2611.32127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kidney transplantation is the optimal treatment for life-threatening end-stage renal disease, providing significant survival advantages over dialysis. Given the severe shortage of donor organs, accurately predicting the time to premature graft failure is an essential clinical task for optimizing organ allocation and tailoring individualized immunosuppressive therapies. This study is motivated by a comprehensive United Network of Organ Sharing (UNOS) dataset containing 243,443 kidney transplant records with complex multi-region structures and high right-censoring rates. translated_abstract: 肾移植是危及生命的终末期肾病的最佳治疗方式，与透析相比具有显著的生存优势。鉴于供体器官的严重短缺，准确预测移植物过早失效的时间是优化器官分配和制定个体化免疫抑制治疗方案的一项重要临床任务。本研究受一个全面的器官共享联合网络（UNOS）数据集的启发，该数据集包含243,443条肾移植记录，具有复杂的多区域结构和较高的右删失率。我们提出了EnSurv（生存engression），这是一种深度生成式生存分析框架，旨在捕捉复杂的非线性临床协变量交互作用，以建模移植物失效时间。在前加性噪声模型家族中，EnSurv通过优化结合了合并Kaplan-Meier尾部补全的能量评分来处理右删失问题。我们识别了合并c……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了深度生成式生存分析框架EnSurv，利用结合Kaplan-Meier尾部补全的能量评分处理右删失数据，以捕捉非线性临床协变量交互作用，从而准确预测肾移植后移植物失效时间，服务于器官分配优化与个体化免疫抑制治疗。
en_tdlr: This study proposes EnSurv, a deep generative survival framework that handles right-censoring via an energy score augmented with pooled Kaplan-Meier tail completion to capture complex nonlinear covariate interactions, enabling accurate prediction of kidney graft failure time to support organ allocation and individualized immunosuppressive therapy.
